verdict.rationale: The docs say AI Gateway automatically retries requests on other providers when one fails. Platform engineers can set the provider failover order with `order`, `only`, and `sort` in `providerOptions.gateway`, and per-provider timeouts trigger fast failover. BYOK requests also fall back to system credentials. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of fallback to a different model (not just a different provider), and independent or hands-on corroboration that failover works as claimed.
